title: Epic Health
description: epichealth.com.au Epic Health is an Australian medical group founded in 2001 in Melbourne, running multiple brands including Epic Medical general practice, Epic Youth Health, Epic Skin Health and Alevia Medical Weight Loss. Its fastest-growing division is Alevia, offering doctor-supervised weight loss programs using GLP-1 medications like Mounjaro and Ozempic across four clinics plus telehealth Australia-wide. The group combines traditional family medicine with niche verticals like dermatology, adolescent health and aesthetic medicine under one team-based model. Led by medical director Dr. Neeraj Mahindra, it serves patients nationally through Medicare-compatible telehealth with instant rebates and a dedicated digital app. Key strengths are 24 years of operation, a debt-free financial position and multi-brand diversification into high-demand health niches. The company is well positioned in Australia's booming medical weight loss and telehealth markets.
